title: Ashgrove Fixed Indexed Annuities Contract Data — Annuitization and Maturity
content:
**Contract data page section — Fixed Indexed Annuities**

| Term | IndexEdge 5 | IndexEdge 7 | IndexEdge 10 | IndexEdge 10 Bonus | IncomeShield 7 | IncomeShield 10 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| First contract year in which annuitization is free of surrender charge | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Shortest period certain for charge-free annuitization without a life contingency (years) | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 |
| Maturity age (annuitant age at which the contract must be annuitized or paid out) | 95 | 95 | 95 | 95 | 95 | 95 |

### The three terms in words

- On every tier, contract year 2 is the first contract year in which annuitization is free of surrender charge.
- An income option with no life contingency must have a period certain of at least 5 years to count toward charge-free annuitization.
- The maturity age is the annuitant's age of 95; at that age the contract must be annuitized or paid out.

### Hypothetical readings against the period-certain term

| Income option without a life contingency | Against the 5-year term |
|---|---|
| 5-year period certain | At least 5 years |
| 10-year period certain | At least 5 years |
| 3-year period certain | Shorter than 5 years |

The maturity age is read from the annuitant's age, not the owner's: a contract whose annuitant reaches 95 has reached its maturity age even where the owner is younger (hypothetical).
